info.title: Thred API
info.description: Thred is the data API for the phone. Use Collect when you know who to ask: send a phone number and instructions, add context values in input, and define the answers you want with a JSON Schema in output. Use the same base URL for Development and Production; your API key selects the environment.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Verify the workspace and environment selected by your API key.

tags.name: Collect
tags.description: Collect structured answers from a known phone number.

get.description: Check whether the API service responds. No API key is needed.
Check your key and see its workspace and environment.

post.description: Collect answers from a known phone number. Send instructions, optional context values in input, and a JSON Schema in output. Use the returned ID to retrieve the result, or provide a webhook_id. Development and Production can both place real calls.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key for retrying a request without creating another collection. Omit it to create a new collection on each POST. Reuse the same key only with the same request; a different request returns 409. Use 1–200 printable, non-space ASCII characters.

requestBody.description: The destination, task, input context, and output JSON Schema.

example.instructions: Ask whether the business is open on the date in input and what time it closes.

202.description: New collection accepted, or an existing idempotent request returned.

get.description: List collections in your workspace and API environment, newest first. Pass next_cursor as cursor to get the next page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection ID returned when the request was accepted. IDs use the call_ prefix.

get.description: Get the latest collection status and results. Keep polling until status is completed, incomplete, failed, or canceled. Read completed answers from data and incomplete answers from partial_data.

200.description: The current collection and its published results.

screener_sequence.message: Hello, I am calling to confirm today’s business hours.

request.instructions: Ask whether the business is open on the date in input and what time it closes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection ID returned when the request was accepted. IDs use the call_ prefix.

post.description: Request cancellation of an open collection, then poll for its final status. No request body is needed. Repeated requests and requests for already closed collections return the current state.

202.description: Cancellation recorded, or the current state of an already closed or cancel-requested collection.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The collection ID returned when the request was accepted. IDs use the call_ prefix.

get.description: Recording is currently disabled on the hosted API. When enabled and ready, this endpoint returns a private playback link valid for approximately 15 minutes.
Read daily collection counts and elapsed job seconds for 1–31 inclusive UTC days. Both dates default to today. Usage is attributed to the collection’s creation date and is not a billing statement.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC date, inclusive. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC date, inclusive. Must be on or after from and no more than 30 days later. Defaults to today.

200.description: Daily operational usage for the selected API environment.

bearerAuth.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <THRED_API_KEY>. Development keys begin thr_dev_; Production keys begin thr_prod_. Each key is scoped to a workspace and environment. Keep secrets on your server.

Environment.description: The API key selects the workspace environment. Development and Production are isolated, but either can place real calls when enabled.

CallStatus.description: Final: completed, incomplete, failed, canceled. Continue polling for all other statuses.

CallHandling.description: Who is handling the call: AI, waiting for an internal operator, or an internal operator.

environment.description: API deployment environment. This is not the environment selected by an API key.

workspace_id.description: Workspace associated with the API key.

key_id.description: Identifier of the authenticated key; never the key secret.

extension.description: Extension hint, used when an appropriate extension-entry prompt is heard.

language.description: Language tag, such as en or fr-CA.

Navigation.description: Optional routing hints. IVR navigation is automatic. Custom routes, actions, and navigation policy overrides are not accepted.

message.description: Approved spoken copy; must contain non-whitespace text.

type.description: The first message must be intro; all later messages must be detail.
One supported type, or an array containing one supported non-null type and null. An object schema must include properties and additionalProperties: false; an array schema must include items.

description.description: Explain what the answer should contain.

properties.description: Object fields. Names must contain 1–120 characters and cannot be __proto__, prototype, or constructor.

additionalProperties.description: A nested schema with the same supported fields. Every node needs type; objects need properties and additionalProperties: false; arrays need items.

required.description: Unique names declared in properties. Required answers that cannot be obtained prevent a completed result.

additionalProperties.description: Required and always false for every object schema.

items.description: The schema for each array item, using the same supported fields.

enum.description: Primitive string, number, boolean, or null values. Each value must satisfy the declared type and bounds.

OutputSchemaNode.description: Supported JSON Schema fields. Maximum 128 nodes and 8 nesting levels below the root. Keywords must match their type; minimum bounds cannot exceed maximum bounds.

type.description: Optional. The output root is always an object; omit this field when creating a collection.

description.description: Explain what the answer should contain.

properties.description: Object fields. Names must contain 1–120 characters and cannot be __proto__, prototype, or constructor.

required.description: Unique names declared in properties. Required answers that cannot be obtained prevent a completed result.

additionalProperties.description: Required and always false for every object schema.

OutputSchema.description: The JSON Schema defining the answers returned in data. The output root is always an object, so no top-level type is needed. Define properties and required fields, and set additionalProperties to false.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format.

instructions.description: What you want to find out. Thred manages conversation, navigation, and assistance. Must contain non-whitespace text.

input.description: Known context values for the call, such as a date, product name, or reference number. Must be a JSON object; optional and defaults to an empty object. Up to 16,000 bytes of JSON. Maximum depth: 32; maximum values: 8,192.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum job duration. Your workspace and environment may have a lower limit.

caller_number_id.description: Enabled caller number ID belonging to the same workspace and environment. Omit to use the environment default.

webhook_id.description: Enabled webhook endpoint ID from your dashboard, in the same workspace and environment. Omit to poll for results.

screener_sequence.description: An intro followed by optional detail messages for screeners. If omitted, Thred prepares a sequence from the task and input before dialing.

metadata.description: Your tracking fields, up to 4,000 bytes of JSON. Maximum depth: 32; maximum values: 8,192.

record.description: Recording is currently disabled. Leave false or omit; true returns 503.

CreateCallRequest.description: Send UTF-8 JSON, up to 64 KiB. Unknown fields are rejected.

CallRequestSnapshot.description: The accepted request with defaults applied and text normalized. Client metadata remains available here.

id.description: The collection ID, using the call_ prefix. Use it to retrieve or cancel the collection.

reused.description: True when the same idempotency key and normalized request already existed. No new collection is created.

RecordingStatus.description: Recording progresses independently of the call result. Hosted recording is currently disabled.

audio_started_at.description: Start of the recording audio clock, when available.

elapsed_job_seconds.description: Elapsed job duration, including setup and waiting. Not a billable duration.

billed_seconds.description: Always null until provider billing reconciliation is available.

digits.description: Digits sent to the phone menu.

reusable.description: Whether successful steps are eligible for automatic reuse on a matching future call.

id.description: The collection ID, using the call_ prefix.

from.description: Outbound caller number in E.164 format.

updated_at.description: UTC time of the latest update.

started_at.description: UTC job start time, or null before startup.

ended_at.description: UTC job end time, or null until closure. Results may still be processing afterward.

human_assisted.description: Whether an internal operator assisted the live call. Assisted results require approval before publication.

outcome.description: Call closure reason, when known. Use status to determine whether results are final.

data.description: Complete answers matching output, or null before publication / when no complete result exists.

partial_data.description: Available answers when a complete result could not be obtained. Missing required fields may be omitted, but remaining schema constraints still apply.

missing_fields.description: Validation messages for unavailable answers, including the field path. Empty for completed and canceled collections.

error.description: Collection failure details. This is separate from an HTTP error response.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed job duration; not provider billable talk time.

cancellation_requested.description: True once a cancellation request is recorded; does not by itself mean the call has ended.

screener_sequence.description: Prepared or supplied screener messages, or null while preparation is pending.

screener_sequence_source.description: Whether screener messages were supplied or generated.

navigation_cache_source_call_id.description: Prior call whose eligible navigation steps were loaded, or null.

Call.description: A collection and its published results. List responses return this shape. Detail responses also include navigation_routes.

navigation_routes.description: Observed IVR navigation routes for this call.
Included when the call is already closed, terminal, or previously marked for cancellation.

Cancellation.description: Current collection state. Retrieve the collection to confirm it reaches a terminal status.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null means there are no more results.

url.description: Temporary private playback URL. Treat the URL as a secret.

expires_at.description: UTC expiry time, approximately 15 minutes after issuance.

requested.description: Accepted collections, counted once. Idempotent replays do not increment this count.

human_assisted.description: Finalized collections that had live human assistance.

elapsed_job_seconds.description: Operational elapsed duration recorded on physical call closure.

billed_seconds.description: Always null; these counters are not billing reconciliation.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request, schema, destination, duration, caller number, webhook, or date range. Inspect error.code and error.message.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, invalid, revoked, or environment-mismatched bearer API key.

NotFound.description: No matching collection in this key’s workspace and environment, or the endpoint does not exist.

Conflict.description: This idempotency key already belongs to a different normalized request.

TooLarge.description: The UTF-8 request body exceeds 64 KiB.

RateLimited.description: The workspace or environment concurrent-call, per-minute, or maximum-duration limit was exceeded. Codes: capacity_exceeded, rate_limited, or limit_exceeded.

Unavailable.description: Calling or the backend is unavailable. Codes include calling_unavailable, environment_unavailable, not_configured, and backend_unavailable.

RecordingUnavailable.description: Recording is not ready or storage identity cannot be verified. Recording is currently disabled on the hosted API.
